name: Appel
storyline: Micro Manager, in his desperation to gain the power of the golden apples has begun to take control of planet Appelmoeshapje. As Micro Manager's influence grows, Appel finds not only the inhabitants of, but the very world is turning against him! - Help Appel to navigate through each level, avoiding danger, collecting as many golden apples as you can before finally facing Micro Manager and restoring peace to the world.
summary: Appel is a platformer game created by Griffpatch. In this game, you play as Appel, and adventure through the world of Appelmoshapje. Navigate through each level, collecting as many yellow apples as you can, then face Micro Manager and restore peace to the world. The game has 9 levels, a level editor, and much more.
